relocation.description: Proposed task relocation after local dry-run validation; does not reserve capacity or attest remote source admission

total_build_time_ms.description: Total build time across all targets

source_sync.description: Complete ordinary source synchronization receipt, including host/path bindings and failed transfers; null when synchronization was bypassed or the build used strict snapshots

error.description: Coordinator failure that prevents completion, even when an individual worker succeeded

task_key.description: Retained platform or platform@triple task identity

native_execution.description: Most recent native execution boundary, or the later verification boundary that refused the result. This is observed command/transport evidence, not proof that Cargo or rustc ran or that a timeout supervisor fired.

timeout_seconds.description: Configured phase deadline, not measured elapsed time; null when this boundary has no applicable configured deadline

transport_timeout_seconds.description: Configured transport deadline, which can include host-supervisor cleanup grace

command_exit_code.description: Original observed command/transport exit before DSR normalization; zero with a validation failure means the returned evidence was refused, and null means no such command result was observed

failure_kind.description: Whether the command failed or its evidence was refused; null when this boundary succeeded, even if later artifact collection fails

build_program_dispatched.description: Whether the final guarded build program was sent to the execution transport. True does not prove that its pre-build checks passed or that Cargo or rustc started

task_key.description: Durable build task identity: platform for a singleton or workflow, platform@target_triple for a native variant matrix

target_triple.description: Explicit native compiler target triple; qualified task identities may retain an approved host assignment independently of sibling variants

duration_ms.description: Per-target elapsed time, converted from native duration_seconds when no millisecond measurement exists; not compiler-only timing

artifact_paths.description: Authoritative artifact paths for this task, retaining every workspace output

log_file.description: Private native attempt log, distinct from the coordinator worker transcript at log_path

result_path.description: Path to the retained target result or coordinator refusal; absent when no receipt could be written

attempt.description: Durable target attempt reservation number, or zero before any reservation

exit_code.description: Target outcome code; skipped targets use the dispatch or interruption reason, not a compiler exit

stage.description: Failure stage; dispatch means the worker was not started, source_sync means no compiler or capacity slot was started, host_capacity means slot acquisition failed before backend launch, host_readiness means native host admission refused before compilation

execution_started.description: True when the coordinator observed a launched worker; false on a dispatch refusal. This does not establish compiler execution: native host readiness may still refuse the attempt

backend_started.description: Worker-owned observation that its build backend was launched after capacity acquisition; false for a host_capacity refusal. True does not establish compiler execution because native host readiness can still refuse

worker_exit_code.description: Actual worker process exit observed by the coordinator when recovering a missing or invalid worker receipt

receipt_source.description: Identifies a result synthesized by the coordinator without claiming the worker wrote a receipt

source_sync.description: Original synchronization receipt for this target's selected host

build_influence_env.description: Effective configured build environment retained from the target result, with case-insensitive Windows names normalized by the native worker

cargo_isolation.description: Complete Cargo isolation and provenance receipt retained from the target result, including available dependency-cache, toolchain-identity, and Windows command-context evidence; the same receipt is retained in manifest build_environments
